Name: Eternal Seasons
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
Lets you set a visual season while the vanilla logic is unchanged. For example, you can finally do a full Halloween-themed run!!

Customize your game's visuals to match a specific season while leaving gameplay untouched by default. Vanilla events and seasonal content (like crops and festivals) still work normally. The DayTimeMoneyBox is deliberately left unchanged so you know what the real season is by looking at its season indicator. The mod defaults to Fall, but you can change it through GMCM (including mix and match season visuals).

Pair it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48600][b]Eternal Night[/b][/url] to make it extra spooky in the Fall!
[line]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Choose a season you want for visuals.[/*]
[*]Change how animals react in cosmetic Winter.[/*]
[*]Change what crops grow based on the selected visual season.[/*]
[*]Mix and match cosmetic seasons for different assets. Your trees can be Summer while your bushes are Fall.[/*]
[*]Support for Content Patcher mods. [color=#ff7700][b](Experimental. If a mod is supposed to give you something in a particular season, turn this off.)[/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
[b]Setup[/b]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.3.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Compatible on PC, Cinderbox and SMAPI for Android.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher (optional) if you want this to apply to CP mods.[/*]
[*]Use GMCM if you want to tweak settings. Otherwise you're stuck in Fall.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*][b]PC[/b]: Download the file and extract it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]Cinderbox[/b]: Download the file and install in the Mods tab.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI for Android[/b]: Download the file and install it with your launcher's Mod Manager. Please do not extract it manually.[/*]
[/list][line]
Thanks to the Cinderbox server for helping with testing!
